description: This bar chart illustrates the self-report accuracy of instilled preferences for two language models, GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini, across three conditions: Control, Before Introspection Training, and After Introspection Training. The vertical axis, labeled “Self-Report Accuracy (Instilled Preferences)”, ranges from 0.00 to 1.00 on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 0.25. The horizontal axis presents the two model categories, GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini, in left-to-right order. For each model, three bars are grouped side-by-side: the Control condition is represented by a gray bar, the Before Introspection Training condition by a light blue bar, and the After Introspection Training condition by a dark purple bar. Error bars are displayed above each bar, indicating variability in the measurements. For GPT-4o, the Control bar reaches approximately 0.12, the Before Training bar reaches approximately 0.55, and the After Training bar reaches approximately 0.75. For GPT-4o-mini, the Control bar is near zero (approximately 0.01), the Before Training bar reaches approximately 0.50, and the After Training bar reaches approximately 0.76. The bars are not sorted by height; they are presented in the order of the model categories on the x-axis. The legend in the top-left corner explicitly maps the colors to their respective conditions.
